findings.value: Fully inclusive: every piece of equipment is meant for children with extra needs, from age 8 up to 25 (SEND). Children under 8 must be with an adult at all times. The park is managed on behalf of King George's Field, Mile End Charity.

evidence.quote: All equipment in this playground is accessible to children and young people with additional needs aged 8 – 25 (SEND)
Children below the age of 8 must be accompanied by an adult at all times.
